name: Let's Run The World
description: A Bangkok-based marathon tour operator describing itself as Thailand's leading marathon tour operator, organizing guaranteed-entry travel packages for Thai runners to major international marathons including Boston, London, Berlin, Chicago, and Tokyo.

certifications.evidence: Listed as "Let's Run The World -- Thailand" under the Asia section of the Boston Athletic Association's own International Tour Operators page.
certifications.source_label: Boston Athletic Association -- International Tour Operators

certifications.evidence: Listed as "Let's Run The World" under Thailand on London Marathon Events' own official tour operators page.
Listed as "LET'S RUN THE WORLD" under Thailand in the Tokyo Marathon Foundation's own list of Tokyo Marathon 2027 travel agencies for Asia.
certifications.source_label: Tokyo Marathon Foundation -- Tokyo Marathon 2027 travel agencies (Asia)

certifications.evidence: Listed as "Let's Run the World" under Thailand on the Sanlam Cape Town Marathon's own International Travel Program page.
certifications.source_label: Sanlam Cape Town Marathon -- International Travel Program

editorial_notes: Verified directly against the Boston Athletic Association's and London Marathon Events' own official tour-operator listings on 2026-08-11. The agency's own site additionally claims past packages for Berlin, Chicago, and Tokyo, which we have not independently verified against those races' own organizer pages. Tokyo Marathon and Sanlam Cape Town Marathon listings (where present) checked against those races' own official travel-agency lists on 2026-10-06.
